name: Guard Robot
source:
A robot that is patrolling the junkyard, which is the property of K Robotics Co., Ltd.

[spoiler]Robot's real name is Andrew, named after Andrew Warner who is an entrepreneur who helps startups by running a site where proven entrepreneurs teach.

He used to be a high-end model in his time, whose job was to escort important individuals.[/spoiler]
